text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Uuu... I'm so nervous~... I'm happy to 
get an award for my book report, but...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I never imagined I'd have to give a 
speech at the award ceremony...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Huh? Dober-san...?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Could it be that you got a 
certificate too, Dober-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Huh!? R-Rob Roy...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
…………"Me too", meaning... Rob Roy, did you, 
um, get an award for drawing too...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, mine is a book report, but— Y-You have 
to give a speech too, Dober-san. It makes 
you nervous, doesn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ? Um... Dober-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! S-Sorry...! How should I put it, um, 
well............!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Their fingertips are trembling 
slightly... It seems they're even more 
nervous than I am...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (—Oh, that's it!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Back when my little brother entered a 
craft competition. To him, nervous as he 
was, I—)

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do, Sis...? I might be 
totally hopeless...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's not true...! You've worked so hard 
for this. So please, hold your head high—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—I know! Big Sis will cast a magic charm 
on you! Then everything will definitely be 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hah! Take that—!! Hyaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"—Having endured a blow from my blade, 
thou shalt henceforth withstand any 
pain!!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was, um...! I-It's a kind of good 
luck charm...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I did it for my little brother once a long 
time ago... and it really helped him gain 
confidence—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So I thought of giving it to Dober-san 
too, but... I-I'm sorry if it doesn't 
work...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ......I see, for my sake...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, thank you. I'll do... my best 
with the speech.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank goodness, you're smiling 
again...! Let's both do our very best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the school assembly, awards were 
presented, and Zenno Rob Roy gave a speech 
with a dignified presence.
choice_data_list: (Maybe I'll go talk to her later.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the meeting, Zenno Rob Roy was 
chatting with Mejiro Dober with a look of 
relief.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: âAh, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I really haven't done anything that 
special, but... Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, you did great. Thanks to your charm, 
Rob Roy, I managed to pull through too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She told me about a charm she used on her 
little brother to relieve his nerves long 
ago, and how she had just done the same 
for Mejiro Dober.
choice_data_list:
Rob Roy, you gave a magnificent speech as 
well

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's really nothing that 
impressive...! I just happen to have a 
younger brother...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You think so? You were really dependable 
back there. Rob Roy almost looked like the 
older one.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, compared to your usual composure, 
Dober-san, I'm nowhere near that...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Still, if that's even a little bit of 
what you think, it makes me truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: D-Do you think so...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I'm sure it's because 
I was with you, Dober-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh... Me?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was precisely because we 
understood each other's nervousness. With 
anyone else, I would have been far more 
nervous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, you might be right. Maybe we're 
two peas in a pod after all.
